"""Provide the owned CODE-EVAL-002 page_count fixture."""

import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def page_count(items, page_size):
    """Compute integer ceiling items divided by positive page_size; reject negative items and nonpositive page_size with ValueError."""
    logger.info("ce002_fixture_called function=page_count")
    if items < 0 or page_size <= 0:
        raise ValueError("invalid page bounds")
    return (items + page_size - 1) // page_size
